title: Pricing & Fees

Pricing built for businesses of all sizes
Features available out of the box:
195 countries Accept payments around the world with cardholder support in 195+ countries.
135+ currencies Process charges and display prices in your customer’s preferred currency to increase conversion.
100+ payment methods From Alipay to iDEAL, seamlessly support popular payment methods.
1 integration Accept payments globally through a single integration.
Powerful machine learning Detect and block fraud using machine learning trained on data across millions of companies.
Adapts to new fraud patterns Adapt faster to the latest trends with Radar’s machine learning.
No integration required Get started with zero code thanks to Stripe’s built-in fraud protection.
Fraud analytics Monitor your fraud performance with advanced analytics and alerting.
Flexible UI components Use UI building blocks to design a secure payments experience that perfectly matches your site.
Pre-built payment forms Embed a prebuilt payments form into your website or direct customers to a Stripe-hosted page.
Accelerated checkout Autofill your customers’ saved cards to deliver a frictionless checkout experience.
No-code payments Accept payments in minutes by generating no-code links.
Real-time retries Increase revenue with selective retries powered by machine learning.
Auto-updated cards Update card information in real-time, improving customer experience and increasing revenue.
Customer authentication Verify a customer’s identity using 3D Secure, an authentication method for card transactions
Seamless onboarding Onboard and verify users with conversion-optimized UIs.
Platform management Manage payment operations with tools for your platform and your users.
Embedded components Embed and white label payment workflows for your users.
Risk tools Access tools to help you mitigate risk for your connected accounts.
Fast, predictable payouts to your bank accounts
Flexible payout options Opt to receive transfers on a rolling basis, weekly, or monthly.
Like-for-like settlement In select regions, get paid out in your preferred currencies.
Payout transparency See upcoming payouts, expected deposit dates, payout history, and more in the Dashboard.
24x7 support Our team is here to help over email, phone, or chat. You can even get email support in 6 languages.
Industry-leading documentation Build using our robust technical docs. Sample code in 8+ languages.
Technical support on Discord Chat with our technical team on the official Stripe Developer Discord server.
99.999% average historical uptime Maximize your revenue with a platform that handles 250 million+ API requests a day, while maintaining 99.999% uptime.
PCI compliant Use our libraries to collect payment information without sensitive data ever hitting your servers.
Regulatory licenses globally Stripe is certified to the highest industry standards and has obtained regulatory licenses around the world.
